investor.subject: Your ceiling, a comparison, a report
investor.preheader: Three things to try this week.
investor.headline: Three things to try this week
body: Offer Ceiling: the highest price that still meets your targets. Set the targets once and it recalculates for every deal.
Compare: put two deals side by side. Your trial includes one comparison, so pick the two you are deciding between.
Report: export a PDF with the numbers and the assumptions behind them. It is written for a lender or a partner to read without you in the room.

agent.subject: A ceiling, a comparison, a client report
agent.preheader: Three things to try this week.
agent.headline: Three things to try this week
body: Offer Ceiling: the highest price that still meets a client's targets. Set their targets once and it recalculates for every listing.
Compare: put two listings side by side. Your trial includes one comparison, so pick the two a client is deciding between.
Report: export a PDF with the numbers and the assumptions behind them. On Agent Pro it carries your logo.
